ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: library
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: Bookcases along the back wall, two armchairs with a bedside table between them, a light and a plant.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A quiet room to read in. Books teach skills, pass the time, and on a bookcase they speed up research nearby.

tips.li: Reading counts as recreation, and some books teach a skill while they're read. A good library is used every day.
Books on a bookcase don't deteriorate, and they add to the room's beauty.
Comfortable chairs and good light make reading more pleasant. Armchairs are worth the cloth.
Build it next to the laboratory: books on a bookcase there speed up research too.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: tavern corner
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A table with six seats, fermenting barrels along the wall, a shelf for the beer, a light and a plant.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Somewhere to sit with a drink after work. Beer is recreation, and the barrels are right there.

tips.li: Beer cheers people up and counts as recreation, but some colonists get a taste for it. Set a drug policy.
Fermenting barrels work between 7 °C and 32 °C, so a heated room keeps the beer coming in winter.
A table in the tavern is also a dining table: the hungry eat here, the thirsty drink.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: kennel
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: Four animal beds along the back wall, a shelf for kibble and a heater. For dogs, cats and other pets.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Pets that sleep warm and dry stay healthy, and a kennel near the bedrooms keeps them close at night.

tips.li: Animals in a bed or a sleeping box rest better than on the ground, and they don't freeze in winter.
Keep kibble or hay on the shelf here, and restrict the pets to an area that includes the kennel.
Bonded pets follow their master around by day. A kennel near the bedrooms keeps them close at night too.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: hydroponics bay
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: Six hydroponics basins in pairs with walkways between them, one sun lamp in the middle and a heater.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Food all year, on any ground: rice and potatoes under a lamp while the fields outside are frozen.

tips.li: Every basin needs a walkway beside it, or its plants can't be sown and cut. Pairs of basins share one.
One sun lamp covers this whole room. Its light switches off at night, when the plants rest anyway.
Basins kill their plants within hours without power. Batteries or a generator in reserve keep the harvest safe.
Rice grows fastest. Plant it here when food is short, and something better later.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: stonecutter's workshop
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: Two stonecutter's tables, a tool cabinet and a light, for turning rock chunks into blocks.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Stone blocks don't burn: walls of stone are what keep a fire or a raid from spreading through the base.

tips.li: A stockpile for chunks right outside the door saves the cutter most of the walking.
Cutting is slow at first. A colonist with some Crafting skill does it much faster.
Marble makes the most beautiful blocks, granite the strongest walls.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: component workshop
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A fabrication bench for components and advanced parts, a tool cabinet and a light.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Components run out. A fabrication bench makes new ones from steel, so the colony stops depending on traders.

tips.li: A component takes 12 steel and some skill. Keep the best crafter on this bench.
A tool cabinet next to the bench speeds up the work.
Advanced components also need plasteel and gold. Keep some of both on hand before the research is done.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: guard post
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small room by the gate: a chair facing the door, a weapons shelf, a light and a heater.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A warm place for whoever watches the gate, with weapons close at hand when the first shot is fired.

tips.li: Build it where raiders usually come from, at the end of the killbox or beside the main gate.
Weapons on the shelf here let the guards arm themselves where the fight starts.
Thick walls and a light: a guard who can see the gate sees raiders coming.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: trophy gallery
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: Columns, pedestals for sculptures, lights and open floor: a room to show off the colony's art.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Sculptures make any room more beautiful, and a room full of them is impressive. Colonists enjoy looking at art.

tips.li: Sculptures are made at the art bench and moved in by hand: install them on the open floor or on the pedestals.
Columns and fine floors add beauty of their own, so even an unfinished gallery looks good.
Masterwork and legendary pieces are worth putting where colonists pass every day: the dining room or the gallery.
Pedestals come from furniture mods (Vanilla Furniture Expanded, Medieval Overhaul). Without them the gallery still works.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: longhouse
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A long shared hall for a tribe: ten bedrolls along the walls, a fire in the middle and a torch.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: The whole tribe under one roof and around one fire, warm through the winter.

tips.li: A campfire inside heats the whole hall. Keep it fed with wood, or the longhouse turns cold at night.
Wooden walls burn. Keep the fire in the middle, away from the walls and the bedrolls.
Sleeping together costs a little mood, but it's warm and cheap. Move people into huts as the tribe grows richer.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: great hall
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A medieval hall with two long tables for sixteen, a brazier or torch in each corner and a stone floor.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Where a medieval colony eats, feasts and gathers. A fine hall is a mood bonus with every meal.

tips.li: The hall is where feasts, weddings and the council's meetings happen. Make it the colony's finest room.
Braziers light the hall and add a little beauty. Keep them fueled before a feast.
Stone floors don't burn and wear well under many feet.
